dashboards.spyros-adventure: First promotional material, cool renders, some weird website assets they used, which they kinda forgot about.
dashboards.giants: Mostly just character files, but also some cool island ones as well! They were still doing cute hover effects for the skylanders on the website.
dashboards.swap-force: More character art, some weird banners, elemental backgrounds that were used in Trap Team as well.
dashboards.trap-team: Cool trap images and also some polaroids of some villains. The villain backdrops are also kinda cool.
dashboards.superchargers: Some banger assets of the vehicles and some beautiful artwork for some assets.
dashboards.imaginators: Mostly just icons, so I'll have to keep looking for more artwork of the actual characters
dashboards.lost-islands: The game got a revival because of JesseTheLamest. I ripped all the graphics AND the models which is AWESOME. You can check them out in a model view as well.
dashboards.ring-of-heroes: Aside from all the shitty gacha icons, there's some beautiful artwork for the different towns, and cool character equipment!
dashboards.battlecast: CARD ILLUSTRATIONS AHHHHHH THEY LOOK SO COOOOOL

lostIslandsHero.title: 3D Model Archive
lostIslandsHero.description: 616 extracted models with textures. You can browse the meshes, and texture sheets ripped from the game. They should have their boning as well alongside weight paint, but it seems a bit wonky. I couldn't make sense of how to rip the animations as well, but I am on it!

modelViewer.downloadHint: bundles the mesh (.obj + .mtl), texture, and skeleton/skin data (if any) into a zip.
